import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb

# Suppress LightGBM progress bars for cleaner output
import logging

logging.getLogger("lightgbm").setLevel(logging.WARNING)
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Identify target and features
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

# Check if columns exist
if target_col not in train_df.columns:
    raise ValueError(f"Target column {target_col} not found in train.csv")
if id_col not in test_df.columns:
    raise ValueError(f"Id column {id_col} not found in test.csv")

# Separate features and target
y_train = train_df[target_col].values
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in [id_col, target_col]]
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols]

# CRITICAL FIX: Use NON-stratified split to avoid class membership errors
# The data has 7 cover types, some rare. Stratified split fails when
# a class has fewer than 2 members after splitting. Unstratified split works.
val_size = 0.2
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=val_size, random_state=42
)

print(f"Training set size: {len(X_train)}, Validation set size: {len(X_val)}")

# Prepare test data
test_ids = test_df[id_col].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]

# Define LightGBM model with parameters optimized for this dataset
# n_jobs=-1 for parallel processing, force_col_wise for stability
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=6,
    num_leaves=31,
    objective="multiclass",
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise=True,
)

print("Training model...")
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validation accuracy calculation (Genuine hold-out, unstratified)
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy (unstratified hold-out): {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Generate submission
# Predict classes
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission dataframe matching required schema
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})

# Save to submission path - preserve column order and structure
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")

print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(
    f"Prediction distribution: {submission_df['Cover_Type'].value_counts().sort_index().to_dict()}"
)
print("Process completed successfully.")
